title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 4.9
exact_target: Can the number of large components of a monic polynomial’s lemniscate be bounded independently of its degree? The source gives counterexamples and asks for smaller-than-linear, or smaller-than-every-power, growth instead.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2304009 (AMR-022-4009). CC BY 4.0.
Walter K. Hayman and Edward F. Lingham, \emph{Research Problems in Function Theory}, arXiv:1809.07200, 2018. Problem 4.9, its complete Update 4.9, and the relevant chapter notation.
